item.title: [AI:cause/product | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-111497 - Google Brotli
item.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream. Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries betwe… (CISA KEV added 2026-10-27)

item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-109618 - PHP Group PHP
item.description: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code e… (CISA KEV added 2026-10-26)

item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.2] CVE-2026-109619 - PHP Group PHP
item.description: PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code ex… (CISA KEV added 2026-10-26)

item.title: [AI:cause | EXPLOITED | UNKNOWN] CVE-2026-132165 - Drupal Core
item.description: Drupal Core contains a not failing securely vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to take over an existing site or execute arbitrary code via the Drupal installer. Under specific conditions, the attacker can use install.php to attempt to reinstall Drupal on the site. (CISA KEV added 2026-11-24)

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.3] CVE-2026-137308
item.description: markdownify-mcp before 1.2.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass URL validation by supplying DNS names, bracketed IPv6 literals, or IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. Attackers can influence URLs passed to webpage-to-markdown or git-repo-to-markdown through prompt injection to fetch loopback services, internal hosts, and cloud metadata endpoints.

item.description: DeepSeek-Reasonix before 2.53.0 contains a command execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands without user approval because the shellsafe classifier treats git blame and git whatchanged as read-only. Attackers can plant a diff textconv driver in .gitattributes and .git/config so that git blame, triggered via prompt injection or routine use, executes attacker-chosen commands with the user's privile…

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.7] CVE-2026-137057
item.description: llama.cpp from b7118 before b12604 contains an integer underflow vulnerability in llama_grammar_parser::parse_sequence() that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to cause denial of service by supplying GBNF repetitions with max lower than min. Attackers can send a grammar like {5,2} in the grammar field of a llama-server /completion request, wrapping n_opt to generate endless repetition rules that hang the proce…

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.7] CVE-2026-136630
item.description: Electerm before 5.9.0 contains an origin validation vulnerability in the MCP Server widget that allows remote attackers to execute commands by bypassing Host and Origin checks through DNS rebinding. Attackers can lure users to a page that rebinds to 127.0.0.1 and calls unauthenticated MCP tools on port 30837 to run OS commands locally and on open SSH sessions.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.1] CVE-2026-136620
item.description: pain001-mcp 0.0.72 before 0.0.80 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the commit_payment_batch MCP tool that allows attackers to write files outside any output directory via output_file_path. Attackers can stage a batch, reuse the self-issued confirmation_token, and supply absolute, dot-dot, or symlinked paths to create or overwrite server-writable files with generated XML.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 7.1] CVE-2026-136185
item.description: Prismor before 1.57.0 contains a wildcard CORS misconfiguration and missing authentication in its local HTTP API that allows remote attackers to overwrite security policies via cross-origin requests. Attackers can lure a developer to a malicious page that sends PUT requests to /api/policy/global or /api/policy/project, disabling AI agent guardrails and reading session and event data.

item.title: [AI:product | HIGH 8.3] CVE-2026-134827
item.description: Lightdash before 3.212.0 contains an insufficiently protected credentials vulnerability in getGitlabInstallationRepoReadAccess that sends the organization GitLab app token to unverified hosts. Project developers can set the dbt connection host_domain to an attacker-controlled server and capture the token when the AI agent reads the repository, gaining access to every reachable repository.

item.title: [AI:product | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-42010 - Gnu gnutls, Redhat ai inference server
item.description: A flaw was found in gnutls. Servers configured with RSA-PSK (Rivest–Shamir–Adleman – Pre-Shared Key) wrongfully matched usernames containing a NUL character with truncated usernames. A remote attacker could exploit this by sending a specially crafted username, leading to an authentication bypass. This vulnerability allows an attacker to gain unauthorized access by circumventing the authentication process.

item.title: [EXPLOITED | CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-133303 - Mitel MiCollab

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.8] CVE-2026-137090
item.description: build-git-clone before 1.0.4 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the clone() function that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying crafted repository URLs. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters such as ; or $() in the url argument, which is concatenated into a sh -c command, to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

item.title: [CRITICAL 9.2] CVE-2026-137086
item.description: Teracom TCW122B-CM firmware before 4.07 contains a predictable session cookie vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack administrator sessions by guessing tick-counter-derived cookies. Attackers can predict or brute-force the 32-bit cookie from device uptime and login timing to control relays, settings, and administrator credentials.
